Convert RLum-class objects to the XLUM format

convert_rlum2xlum.Rd

Converts Luminescence::RLum objects to XLUM format.

Usage

convert_rlum2xlum(rlum, file = NULL)

Arguments

rlum

Luminescence::RLum or a list of it (required): input object.

file

character (optional): path to an output file where the XLUM file should be written to. If NULL (default), no file is written, but an xml2::xml_document object is returned.

Value

When file is NULL (default), an xml2::xml_document object is returned. Otherwise the document is written to file (with the .xlum extension added automatically if needed) and NULL is returned invisibly.

Details

The function tries to make the best possible conversion of an Luminescence::RLum object to the XLUM format. Supported are Luminescence::RLum.Analysis objects as well as the Luminescence::RLum.Data objects they may contain. Luminescence::RLum.Results objects are not supported.

The input may be a single object or a list of objects. A list of data objects is combined into a single sequence, whereas a list of Luminescence::RLum.Analysis objects produces one <sequence/> per element.

Each analysis record is mapped to a <record/> node holding one or more <curve/> nodes. The measured values are stored as the text content of the <curve/> node, while tValues, xValues, and yValues are kept as node attributes. Additional record attributes, such as curveType and startDate, are transferred where available.

As Luminescence::RLum objects do not distinguish between different samples, the <xlum/> and <sample/> nodes are created automatically, so all converted objects end up in a single sample.

Function version

0.1.0

See also

convert_2xlum, write_xlum, read_xlum, Luminescence::RLum.Analysis

Author

Sebastian Kreutzer, F2.1 Geophysical Parametrisation/Regionalisation, LIAG - Institute for Applied Geophysics (Germany)

Examples

## load example data
data(ExampleData.RLum.Analysis, envir = environment(), package = "Luminescence")

## convert to an in-memory XLUM document
xlum <- convert_rlum2xlum(IRSAR.RF.Data)

## convert and write to a file
convert_rlum2xlum(IRSAR.RF.Data, tempfile(fileext = ".xlum"))
